app.name: MapleLink
announcement.dual_track.title: Development Status & Parallel-Track Notice
announcement.dual_track.intro: MapleLink is developed in parallel with the original Beanfun, to give players a more flexible choice. The two projects have distinct goals:
announcement.dual_track.maplelink: Built purely for MapleStory players; a lightweight rewrite-from-scratch that serves as the proving ground for new tech experiments and fast triage of login issues.
announcement.dual_track.beanfun: Aims to support all Gamania titles, with continued optimization and broad, high-compatibility coverage of the whole ecosystem.
announcement.dual_track.more_info_link: About the parallel development of Beanfun and MapleLink (#323)

toolbox.download.full.title: Install or update from a torrent
toolbox.download.full.intro: The same source the beanfun game manager uses: the whole game folder from the official CDN over BitTorrent, no installer. Best for a fresh install, or whenever you want the complete client in one go.
toolbox.download.full.why_title: Why does MapleLink generate the torrent?
toolbox.download.full.why_body: The official torrent is made for the game manager: its root folder name doesn't match the CDN path, so a normal BitTorrent client finds no files, and there are no other peers. MapleLink only renames that root folder to the real CDN path and changes nothing else — every piece hash stays official, so your client still verifies every byte.
toolbox.download.full.save_error: Couldn't prepare the torrent — please try again later
toolbox.download.full.step_1: Install a BitTorrent client (qBittorrent, for example).
toolbox.download.full.step_2: Open the saved torrent in that client and pick where to save. It carries a web seed pointing at beanfun's CDN, so it downloads straight from the official server even with no other peers; with a game accelerator the traffic goes through beanfun's domain and is usually accelerated too.
toolbox.download.full.step_3: When it finishes you have a complete {{version}} client folder — move or rename it to wherever you want the game installed.
toolbox.download.full.step_4: Finally, point MapleLink's Settings → Game path at {{exe}} inside that folder.
toolbox.download.full.error: Couldn't fetch the full-client details — please try again later

settings.webview_via_proxy_desc: Web content such as the sign-in window doesn't connect through the app by default, so a per-process accelerator or split-tunnel VPN never covers it. Turn this on to route it through the app. Enabled automatically on a mainland-China address; turn it off if sign-in misbehaves.
settings.github_hosts_desc: When an update can't reach GitHub directly, fetch the community-maintained GitHub hosts list and connect straight to those IPs instead of going through a ghproxy mirror. The mapping applies inside this app only — your system hosts file is never touched. It kicks in only after a direct connection fails, so it changes nothing if GitHub already works for you.
settings.compact_ui_desc: Shrink the launcher to a small single-column window — accounts, OTP and Play only — so it can sit next to the game. Other pages keep their size.
announcement.download_source.title: Where to download this
announcement.download_source.intro: We have had reports of unofficial, seemingly repackaged copies of the Beanfun launcher circulating.
announcement.download_source.rule: For every release, the development team gives out one thing: a link to that version’s exe on GitHub. What we hand over is always a link, never a file.
announcement.download_source.tell: So if someone sent you the executable itself, or you got it from a file locker, a forum repost or a chat attachment, it did not come from us. MapleLink and Beanfun publish separately, and neither hands out files on the other’s behalf.
announcement.download_source.act: Before you download it and before you run it, make sure the source is one you can trust. If it did not come from one of the two addresses above, delete it and download it again — a repackaged build can carry anything, and your account and password go through it.
client.title: Game Client Manager
client.warn_overwrite: Repair overwrites mismatched files with the official version. Close the game first, and back up anything you modified yourself. MapleLink never deletes a file.
client.mode_quick_hint: compares file sizes, done in seconds
client.mode_full_hint: hashes every file, slower but exact
client.extra_hint: These files are not in the official manifest. MapleLink leaves them alone; they are listed for your information.
client.all_good: This folder matches the official manifest exactly. Nothing to do.
client.mismatch_note: A wrong size or wrong content does not always mean damage. The manifest is this version's base client, and the game's own updater modifies some files after install (MapleStory.exe, for one). Repairing restores them to the base version, which the game usually re-patches on its next launch. If the game currently runs fine, you can leave these unticked.
client.download_failed_some: {{written}} written, {{failed}} failed. The files that failed were left exactly as they were.
client.rescan_hint: Check again to confirm. After an interruption, checking again picks up where it left off — finished files are not fetched twice.
client.update_available: Does not match the official version
client.no_client_here: No recognisable client in this folder
client.scan_cancelled_body: Only {{done}} of {{total}} files were checked; the rest is unknown. Check again for a complete result.
client.what_changed: {{count}} files to download, {{size}} in total. Afterwards this folder matches the official {{version}}.
client.ready_hint: Pick a check and press Check files to compare this folder against the official manifest.
client.download_tab_hint: This tab only hands over official links and a torrent; Download and install switches to Check & repair to do the work.
toolbox.download.manager_why: It points the gamaniagames:// registry key back at itself. If you use MapleLink's web-launch interception, installing or updating this turns it off until you switch it on again in Settings. For installing and updating, the torrent above or the Check & repair tab covers it.
client.folder_note: Only this window's check and repair use it; the game path in Settings is untouched.
client.direct_hint: Bypass the system proxy and any accelerator. Direct is faster on some lines — worth trying both.
client.auto_install_hint: Pick an empty folder and MapleLink fetches the whole client from the official CDN. You can pause it.
client.manual_install_hint: Download it yourself in a BitTorrent client; MapleLink carries none of the transfer.
client.auto_check_body: With this on, the window runs a quick comparison as soon as it opens — a few seconds — and only asks for you when something is off. You can switch it off any time under Auto check below.
client.auto_check_toggle_hint: Run a quick check whenever this window opens.
